build_feature_extraction_vgg19: build a FeatureExtraction module using pretrained VGG19 to extract multi-layer CNN features from image batches
build_feature_extraction_vgg16: build a FeatureExtraction module using pretrained VGG16 to extract features up to pool4 layer
build_feature_extraction_resnet101: build a FeatureExtraction module using pretrained ResNet101 to extract features up to layer3
run_featureL2Norm: run featureL2Norm on a PyTorch tensor to normalize features along the channel dimension
review_FeatureExtraction_forward: review the FeatureExtraction forward pass that iterates model_list and applies optional L2 normalization
